description: Find BROKEN [[wikilinks]] — the inverse of memory_unlinked_mentions. Reports (1) unresolved: a [[Title]] in a memory's content that matches no LIVE memory title in the same scope/namespace; (2) dangling_edges: stored wikilink edges whose target memory was deleted or superseded. Resolution is by TITLE (memories have no slug) so write [[Exact Title]]. Pass an id to check one memory, or scope/namespace to sweep a partition. Read-only.

id.description: Check one memory by ID. Omit to sweep a whole partition (scope/namespace).

limit.description: Max source memories to inspect in a sweep

namespace.description: Sweep namespace (when no id is given)

scope.description: Sweep scope (when no id is given)

name: memory_link_check
